chunks: As for whatever is in it from Muḥammad ibn Khālid al-Barqī, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār, from Muḥammad ibn Khālid al-Barqī.

key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates direct reporting by the compiler through a stated chain.
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ الصَّفَّارِ: An intermediary transmitter in this sanad/isnad.
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْبَرْقِيِّ: A transmitter whose narrations in the book are being traced through this chain.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Muḥammad ibn Khālid al-Barqī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad for reports transmitted from Muḥammad ibn Khālid al-Barqī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. It documents the author’s transmission route through Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan to Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār and then to Muḥammad ibn Khālid al-Barqī.
